name: Putt Drop
oneLiner: A cozy one-thumb mini golf park for phones: drag back to aim, release to putt. Hand-made holes with water, sand, slopes, bumpers and moving gates.

screenshots.alt: Putt Drop, hole 1 (Dewdrop): aiming a putt with power ring and dotted path on a cozy park fairway
Putt Drop: hole complete card with three stars after a hole in one on hole 1
